title: Master My Stories: Staying in Dialogue When You're Upset
heading: Chapter 4
chapterLocalFacts: The Path to Action names a hidden story step between fact and feeling.
The diagnostic move is to reverse the path from feeling back to story and fact.
The three common bad stories are victim, villain, and helpless stories.
The chapter explicitly warns against treating emotion as irrational or wrong.
bridgeForward: Chapter 5 turns outward and asks how to catch the moment the conversation itself leaves dialogue.

quoteLedger.text: What story am I telling myself?
